Name: Object Group
Description: Object groups are used to define subsets of objects, such as elements and payroll relationships. These groups are used for processing, reporting, and costing distributions.

Name: Object Group Inclusions and Exclusions
Description: Specifies the records that are included in and excluded from an object group. For example, the payroll relationships and payroll assignments are included in a payroll relationship object group. Inclusions and exclusions must be defined for static object groups, but they are optional for dynamic object groups.

Name: Object Group Level Rules
Description: Specifies the formulas associated with dynamic payroll relationship object groups. Formulas can be defined at both payroll relationship and payroll assignment levels.

Name: Object Group Parameter
Description: Specifies the parameters to restrict the population within the object group. For example, you can specify the payroll name for the group.
